description: Grok usage reads its last persisted gauge without a pane read.

home.config_toml:
[accounts.explorer-seat]
kind = "codex"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:test"

[accounts.scout-seat]
kind = "grok"
config_dir_var = "GROK_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:grok-home}}"
pool = "grok:test"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"
